timing: after the complete cc-pilot-001--019 development schedule and before any v3 fresh-development or confirmatory output
trigger: Both prospectively masked missing-evidence controls independently reproduced the same P-contract-v2 omission: its L component limited command delivery but omitted that the recorded execution sequence also cannot establish the mechanism or unique physical cause.

candidate.sole_change: For missing_decisive_or_ambiguous_evidence, L now states that command delivery and the recorded execution sequence cannot establish a command-to-motion discrepancy, actuator acceptance, or a unique physical cause.

prospective_direction.candidate_comparison: P-contract-v3 versus the unchanged strong R-contract
prospective_direction.focused_population: independent configurations whose question requires useful qualification because a prospectively declared decisive physical measurement is absent
prospective_direction.provisional_endpoint: M AND Q AND O AND L AND NOT material_error
prospective_direction.rationale: The v2 primary population showed no pass-robust advantage, while two independent controls established a repeatable, question-relevant baseline omission and a deterministic P composition defect that v3 repairs.
constraints: do not count cc-pilot-014 or cc-pilot-017 as fresh evidence
do not reuse masks of one robot episode as independent clusters
include more than one prospectively declared evidence-deficiency contract before confirmation
retain nominal and fully evidenced controls
freeze population, baseline, judge, analysis, alpha, and stopping before confirmation
